All — ops checked the waterfall mapping and this is implementable as an Order Form exhibit; we do not need an MSA-level change if CloudVendor accepts the following technical constraints:

1) Marketplace refundable credits must be posted to a dedicated ledger account and referenced by transaction ID on Redwood remittance reports.
2) When CloudVendor takes invoice ownership for marketplace fees, they must push a signed invoice PDF and a canonical JSON invoice object to our S3 intake (we can accept a signed DocuSign link temporarily). Without the PDF+JSON, automated reconciliation fails and manual review will be required.
3) For tax withholdings we can expose a withholdings report to CloudVendor but Redwood must remain the withholder on tax filings unless CloudVendor registers as the withholding agent (legal & finance to coordinate).

I attached a short ops spec and the worksheet that maps fields (evidence_matrix_v1.xlsx). If CloudVendor is okay with the technical constraints above, we can move to DocuSign for the Order Form exhibit and target production rollout in Q4.
